proposals.impact: lift 37.5% open rate closer to vigilance benchmark
proposals.observation: The Money Worship automation has an open rate of 37.5% against 16 sends. The Money Vigilance automation, running a comparable audience size (12 sends), sits at 66.67%. The Money Avoidance automation is at 52.63% across 19 sends. Money Worship is the clear outlier, sitting 14 percentage points below Money Avoidance and 29 points below Money Vigilance. Subject line is the single variable most likely to explain a gap this large at small send volumes, and it is the lowest-risk single-file edit available without touching the automation logic or sequence structure.
proposals.proposal: Rewrite the subject line of Email 1 in the Money Worship automation. The current subject is almost certainly framing worship as an identity label, which creates distance rather than recognition. Replace it with a subject line that names the specific behaviour pattern a Money Worship scorer actually does, so the reader sees themselves in it before they open. Use a concrete, specific behavioural detail rather than a category name. The replacement below is written to pass the Sultanic test: it is grounded in something only a person with this script actually does on a Tuesday afternoon, not something 1,000 coaches could write.
